name: Superintendencia de Bancos - Misiones Oficiales Nacionales 2025 (Panama)
description: Official missions of banking-regulator staff: start and end dates, name, surname, cedula, destination, per-diem amount and details - who from the bank supervisor travelled where and when.

name: MEDUCA - Fondo de Equidad y Calidad de la Educacion (FECE) 2022 (Panama)
description: National transparency report on funds transferred to individual schools, 1,750 rows: project/programme name, school, region, amounts transferred and executed - grant-level tracking of education money to named recipients.

name: IDAAN - Listado de tomas de agua cruda (Panama)
description: Raw-water intake points of the national water utility: intake name, easting/northing coordinates, province, district, corregimiento, watershed, source and type - named critical water infrastructure with coordinates.

name: Diario Oficial de la Federacion - SIDOF notas del dia (Mexico)
description: Undocumented JSON API behind Mexico's official gazette. One call for a date (DD-MM-YYYY) returns NotasMatutinas, NotasVespertinas and NotasExtraordinarias; each nota has codNota, section, date, diario id, issuing branch name (nombreCodOrgaUno), issuing secretariat (codOrgaDos), page range, order, status and flags for available HTML/DOC/PDF/image. DETAIL VERIFIED: /dof/sidof/notas/nota/5796377 returned a 33KB single Nota object with the full text and title - so every gazette entry can be expanded to its actual decree, appointment or sanction. Note: the tree already has www.dof.gob.mx scrapes but not this API host.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: DANE Colombia - Catalogo de Microdatos (NADA API)
description: National statistics office microdata catalogue. Each row: internal id, idno, study title, nation, authoring entity, form model, year range, repository id, data-access link, created/changed timestamps, view and download counts and study URL. DETAIL VERIFIED: /api/catalog/MINTIC-OAPES-INTERNET-2010-A-2014 returned a 29KB study object with full DDI metadata - producers, funding agencies, sampling, coverage, contacts (name/affiliation/email) and variable count. The named producers and contacts behind each dataset are the penetrancy here.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: INE Bolivia - ANDA Archivo Nacional de Datos (NADA API)
description: Bolivian national statistics microdata catalogue, same NADA schema: id, idno, title, nation, authoring entity, form model, year range, repository, REDATAM data-access link, timestamps, views and downloads. DETAIL VERIFIED: /api/catalog/BOL-INE-CA-2013 (Censo Agropecuario 2013) returned a 38KB study record with producers, contacts, topics, collection dates and keywords. Bolivia is otherwise almost absent from the tree.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Knesset — agenda motions (KNS_Agenda)
description: Motions for the agenda: motion name, classification, Knesset number, urgency subtype, status, InitiatorPersonID and MinisterPersonID (pivot to KNS_Person), CommitteeID, government recommendation and postponement reason.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Knesset — bill name history (KNS_BillName)
description: Every historical title a bill carried, with the reading stage the title belonged to (NameHistoryTypeDesc). Lets you track a bill through renames; BillID pivots to the bill record.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Knesset — committee sessions (KNS_CommitteeSession)
description: Committee sitting records: room/location, committee id, open-vs-closed type, status, start and finish datetimes, plus SessionUrl and BroadcastUrl.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Knesset — committee agenda items (KNS_CmtSessionItem)
description: The individual items discussed inside a committee sitting: item name, ordinal, status, item type, and the CommitteeSessionID / ItemID that link back to the session and to the underlying bill or query.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Knesset — parliamentary questions (KNS_Query)
description: Parliamentary questions to ministers: subject, urgency type, status, asking PersonID, answering GovMinistryID, submit date and minister reply date. Direct MK-to-ministry accountability trail.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Knesset — parliamentary factions (KNS_Faction)
description: Every faction across all Knessets: name, Knesset number, start and finish dates, IsCurrent flag. Resolves faction_id seen on vote records.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Knesset — government ministries (KNS_GovMinistry)
description: Ministry register with IsActive flag; resolves GovMinistryID appearing on questions, laws and position records.

name: Knesset — Israeli laws (KNS_IsraelLaw)
description: Consolidated statute register: law name, IsBasicLaw, IsBudgetLaw, first and latest publication dates, validity status and validity start/finish dates with notes.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Knesset — statute name history (KNS_IsraelLawName)
description: Historical names of each consolidated statute, joined to both IsraelLawID and the specific LawID amendment that introduced the name.

name: Knesset — enacted laws and amendments (KNS_Law)
description: Each enactment/amendment as published: name, type and subtype (incl. Mandate-era British statutes), Knesset number, publication date, publication series, gazette number and page number.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Knesset — terms and sessions calendar (KNS_KnessetDates)
description: Knesset term register: term name, Knesset number, assembly and plenum ordinals, plenum start and finish dates, IsCurrent.

name: Knesset — plenum agenda items (KNS_PlmSessionItem)
description: Items on each plenary sitting agenda: item name, item type description, ordinal, status and IsDiscussion, linked by PlenumSessionID and ItemID.

name: Knesset — MK identity index (voting service)
description: MK roster used by the voting service: vip_id, mk_individual_id, and surname and first name in both Hebrew and English. The bridge between vote rows and named people.

name: Knesset Research and Information Center — keyword vocabulary
description: Controlled subject vocabulary for MMM papers, Hebrew and English, resolving keyword_id on the document_keyword join table.

name: Israel Registrar of Companies — changes and charges on corporations
description: Per-corporation change events: corporation number, corporation name, request type (e.g. registration of a charge/pledge), status update date, charge id and request type code. The charge/security-interest trail behind an Israeli company.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Israel Registrar of Companies — companies marked for striking off
description: Corporations in the deletion pipeline: corporation number, Hebrew and English name, corporation type, status and sub-status (in deletion proceedings / dissolved by deletion), and publication date of the notice.

name: Israel Registrar of Partnerships
description: Registered partnerships: partnership number, Hebrew and English name, corporation type (incl. foreign partnerships), status, incorporation date and registered address (city, street, house number).

name: Israel Registrar of Non-Profits — registered amutot
description: Full NGO register: amuta number, registration date, Hebrew and English name, status and status-update date, activity classification and registered address. 24 columns per record.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Israel NGOs — donations from foreign state entities
description: Statutory foreign-funding disclosures: amuta number, amuta name, date the donation was received, the NAMED foreign political entity that gave it, and the donor-entity type code. Direct foreign-influence tracing.

name: Israel NGOs — proper management certificate (ishur nihul takin)
description: Year-by-year compliance certificate status per amuta: amuta number and name, certificate year, whether an application was filed, whether the certificate was granted, and last record update.

name: Israel Registrar — public benefit companies (chevrot le-toelet ha-tsibur)
description: CLG-equivalent public benefit companies: registration number, registration date, Hebrew and English name, status, formal objects and activity classification.

name: Israel Official Receiver — companies in liquidation
description: Court liquidation files: file id, company city of operation, file status, petition filing date, date the winding-up order was granted, and date the order was cancelled or frozen.

name: Israel Official Receiver — proofs of debt in bankruptcy and liquidation
description: Creditor claims filed against insolvent estates: claimant class (private/institutional), claim status, system (bankruptcy vs liquidation), debt creation date and the case id the claim attaches to.

name: Israel Official Receiver — individual bankruptcy debtors
description: Personal bankruptcy files: running file number, debtor's city of residence, name of the district court, file status, file opening date, receivership order date and subsequent order dates.

name: Israel — companies in expedited voluntary liquidation
description: Fast-track voluntary winding-up: company number, Hebrew and English name, corporation type, current status, date the liquidation request was approved, expected dissolution date and sub-status.

name: Israel Registrar of Pledges (rasham ha-mashkonot)
description: Secured-interest register: pledge id, registration date, registration status, reason-for-status and status date, asset registration date and asset removal date. Collateral history on Israeli debtors.

name: Israel Registrar of Public Trusts (hekdeshot)
description: Public endowment/trust register: file number, registration date, trust name, stated purposes and funding method. Sibling resources on the same dataset carry the trust's real estate and remaining asset balances.

name: Israel Registrar of Political Parties
description: Registered political parties: party name, registrar party number and the party's full declared objects text.

name: Israel — licensed notaries register
description: Named notaries with licence file number, full name, town and the languages they are certified to notarise in.

name: Israel — certified public accountants register
description: CPA roll: licence number, date the licence was granted, first and last name, town, and practice status (including self-declared non-practising).

name: Israel — licensed real estate brokers
description: Active licensed brokers: licence number, broker full name and city of residence.

name: Israel — licensed private investigators
description: Named licensed private investigators with surname, first name and licence number.

name: Israel — licensed land appraisers (shamai mekarke'in)
description: Appraiser roll: appraiser name, licence number, file number and city.

name: Israel — register of patent attorneys
description: Patent attorney roll with licence number, title, surname and first name, year entered on the register, fee year paid, EMAIL ADDRESS, street address, town and postcode.

name: Israel — prosecutors authorised by the Attorney General
description: Named external and internal prosecutors carrying AG authorisation: first and last name, prosecutor type, statutory basis of the authorisation, the requesting public body, authorisation start and end dates and termination reason.

name: Israel — state engagements with external law firms
description: Committee for the engagement of external counsel: request id, the government body making the request, request date, and the NAMED law firms considered or selected with the selection method. Government-to-private-counsel money trail.

name: Israel Trademark Office — trademark register
description: Trademark records: mark number, figurative flag, link to the official extract on trademarks.justice.gov.il, legal state, national vs international, international mark number, and mark description in Hebrew and English.

name: Israel Trademark Office — holders and licensees
description: The owner-behind-the-mark table: national mark number, client type (individual / foreign corporation), client number, client name in Hebrew and English, client standing (owner vs licensee) and lead-client flag.

name: Israel Patent Office — patent applications
description: Patent applications back to 1917: application number, request and filing dates, invention title in Hebrew and English, international application number and publication number.

name: Israel Patent Office — applicants behind patent applications
description: Applicant entity per application: application number, invention title in Hebrew and English, APPLICANT NAME and APPLICANT ADDRESS in Hebrew and English. Links inventions to named companies and firms.

name: Israel Patent Office — named inventors
description: Inventor names attached to each patent application, in Hebrew and English, with the invention title. Sample record is an electromagnetic gun system — includes defence-adjacent filings.

name: Israel Registrar of Inheritance — applications filed
description: Succession applications: filing date, application type (succession order vs probate), district, whether represented by counsel, application status, publication date and the newspaper that published the notice.

name: Israel — anti human-trafficking coordination unit case file
description: Cases handled by the National Anti-Trafficking Coordinator: case status and status date, opening and closing dates, case type, referral status and date, case subject (e.g. slavery) and the referring body.

name: Israel Appeals Tribunal (immigration/entry) — decisions register
description: Tribunal decision index: application number, case number, which tribunal (e.g. Beer Sheva), the NAMED adjudicator, decision date, application type and subject (e.g. family reunification).

name: Israel — decisive land appraisal decisions (shumot machriot)
description: Betterment-levy appraisal rulings with English column names: appraisal_header naming both parties, appraisal_type, appraiser_type, block and parcel, and the local planning committee. Names private parties against municipal committees.

name: Israel Privacy Protection Authority — registry of personal databases
description: Registered personal-data databases: database number, OWNER ID NUMBER (corporate registration number), owner full name, database name, and the owner's city, street, house number and postbox. Maps which company holds which personal dataset.

name: Israel Police — crime case records by area and quarter
description: Case-level crime records with a fictive case id, year and quarter, locality code and name, and the full police hierarchy: district code and name, region code and name, station code and name, plus offence grouping.

name: Izmir Metropolitan Municipality — council members
description: Named elected council members: serial number, FULL NAME, office held (e.g. Metropolitan Mayor), profession and level of education. New host, not previously in the tree.

name: Izmir — sister-city and cooperation protocols
description: Municipal foreign relations: agreement type (cooperation protocol / sister city), domestic vs foreign, partner COUNTRY and CITY, council resolution number and council resolution date.

name: Bahrain — national-origin exports 2025 (HS line items)
description: 19,901 customs line items: year, month, 8-digit HS commodity code, commodity description (EN and AR), UN country code and destination country name (EN and AR), export value in BHD and USD, weight in kg, quantity and unit of measure. Filterable by partner country, which makes it a working trade-partner pivot for UAE, Saudi and Qatar.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Bahrain — total exports 2026 (HS line items)
description: 24,241 current-year export line items with the same schema: HS code, commodity in English and Arabic, UN code and destination country, value in BHD and USD, weight, quantity and unit.

name: Bahrain — imports 2021 (HS line items)
description: 314,055 import line items: month, HS code, commodity in English and Arabic, origin country code and name, import value in BHD and USD, weight in kg, quantity and unit of measure.

name: Bahrain — inward FDI stocks by counterparty country
description: Annual FDI stock in BHD millions per source country, with geographical region and geographical group classification. Includes offshore jurisdictions such as the Bahamas.

name: Bahrain — quarterly inward FDI stocks by country
description: Quarterly FDI stock in BHD millions by counterparty country with year, quarter, geographical region and group. 4,347 rows, current through 2026 Q1.

name: Bahrain — travel and cargo service establishments
description: 352 NAMED commercial establishments: trading name in English and Arabic, activity type and subtype in both languages (e.g. boat rentals), block number and longitude/latitude. A geolocated business directory, not a statistical table.

name: Bahrain — air quality monitoring stations
description: Named stations with English and Arabic name, operational status, station type (urban/industrial), latitude and longitude in DMS and decimal, and a geo_point field.

name: Qatar — coastal environmental monitoring by location
description: 728 measurements: named parameter (English and Arabic), named monitoring location including the national permissible maximum, measured value and year.

name: India mutual fund scheme name search
description: Name-pivot over the Indian mutual fund universe: returns schemeCode and schemeName for every scheme matching a free-text query. Dispatchable with a fund house or sponsor name to enumerate all of its schemes.

name: Nepal BIPAD - disaster loss records
description: The loss record behind each Nepali disaster incident: peopleDeathCount broken out by male/female/other/unknown/disabled, peopleMissing and peopleInjured with the same breakdown, peopleAffectedCount, familyAffected/Relocated/Evacuated, livestockDestroyedCount, infrastructureDestroyed by house/road/bridge/electricity, infrastructureEconomicLoss, agricultureEconomicLoss and estimatedLoss, plus createdOn/modifiedOn.

name: Nepal BIPAD - critical facility register (health, education, security)
description: Named facility register with geometry: title, resourceType (health / education / financial institution / security), GeoJSON point, ward id, dataSource and lastModifiedDate. The detail record adds staffing (noOfEmployee split by sex and disability), phoneNumber, emailAddress, website, localAddress, opening hours and accessibility flags.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Nepal BIPAD - registered disaster-response organizations
description: Organization register: title (e.g. DAO Sindhupalchok), shortName, longName, description, level, startingDateAd, point geometry, and the province/district/municipality/ward it is bound to plus responsibleFor scope. Detail endpoint verified with id 2.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Nepal BIPAD - named municipal officials and DRR focal persons
description: Named individuals with contact details: name (e.g. Jayaram K.C.), position (C.O.), email, workNumber, mobileNumber, isDrrFocalPerson flag, committee membership, communityAddress, point geometry and the organization / province / district they belong to. Person-level penetrancy into Nepali local government.

name: Nepal BIPAD - earthquake catalogue
description: National Seismological Centre earthquake catalogue: description (source), magnitude, GeoJSON epicentre point, address (district), eventOn timestamp and the ward/municipality/district/province codes. Detail endpoint verified with id 698.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Nepal BIPAD - river gauging stations with exposed population
description: Hydrological station register: title (e.g. Dudhaura Khola at Gadimai), basin name, GeoJSON point, waterLevel and warning/danger thresholds, measuredOn, and affectedDemography giving maleCount, femaleCount and householdCount exposed downstream of that gauge.

name: Nepal BIPAD - rainfall gauging stations
description: Rainfall station register: title (e.g. Surkhet (Birendra Nagar)), point geometry, measuredOn, rainfall totals by interval, and affectedDemography (maleCount, femaleCount, householdCount) for the catchment.

name: Nepal BIPAD - air quality monitoring stations
description: 31 air-quality stations mirrored from pollution.gov.np: name and nepaliName, identifier, dataSource and dataSourceId, dateTime of the reading and the AQI / pollutant values, with createdOn and modifiedOn.

name: Nepal BIPAD - official disaster documents and circulars
description: Government circulars and notices (Nepali and English): title, description carrying the full notice text, category, publication file URL on bipadportal mediafiles, createdOn and modifiedOn.

name: Nepal BIPAD - situation reports
description: Event situation reports: title (e.g. Monsoon 2077 BS), narration (HTML body of the assessment), type, fromDate/toDate and timestamps.

name: Nepal BIPAD - municipality gazetteer with geometry
description: Authoritative local-unit gazetteer: title, title_en, title_ne, type (Rural Municipality / Municipality / Sub-Metropolitan), official code, district id, bbox and centroid point. Resolves a Nepali place name to its official code and extent. Detail endpoint verified with id 1005.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Nepal BIPAD - citizen incident reports
description: Public-submitted incident reports before verification: description of the event, GeoJSON point, image URL, comment, verified flag and createdOn/modifiedOn. Shows what was reported versus what the state later confirmed.

name: Nepal BIPAD - hazard taxonomy
description: The 47-term hazard vocabulary every incident and event joins to: id, title, titleEn, titleNe, type (natural / non-natural), icon URL, colour and ordering. The lookup table that decodes the numeric `hazard` field on incidents.

name: Nepal BIPAD - declared disaster events
description: Named multi-incident events (the umbrella an incident is grouped under): title, description, hazard id, startedOn and endedOn, severity, point and polygon geometry, createdOn.

name: Nepal BIPAD - relief inventory item catalogue
description: Relief-item master: title and titleNe, category (Relief Items non-food, food, medical), unit and unitNp, dimension, occupancy, code, and the hazards/clusters each item is linked to.

name: Nepal BIPAD - relief stock holdings by store
description: Actual stock on hand: the embedded item object (title, category, unit), quantity held, and the owning organization / municipality / ward. Shows which local body is holding which relief materiel and how much.

name: Nepal BIPAD - municipal DRRM profiles
description: Per-municipality disaster risk reduction reports: title (e.g. Rajapur DRRM Report FY 2079/80), titleNp, drrmCommitteeFormationDate, drrmCommitteeMembersCount, and the English/Nepali summary report file URLs. Reveals whether a local body has actually constituted its statutory DRR committee.

name: Nepal BIPAD - relief distribution to named beneficiaries
description: Named-beneficiary payment records: nameOfBeneficiary (e.g. Purna Bahadur Prajapati and Gyan Maya Prajapati), numberOfBeneficiaryFamily, reliefAmountNpr, dateOfReliefDistribution, causeOfIncident and totals benefited by sex, minority and Dalit status. Ties public money to named recipients.

name: Nepal BIPAD - national DRR priority activities
description: The activity level of Nepal's national DRR action plan: title and titleNp of each committed activity, ordering, and the parent priorityAction id. Joinable up to priority-action and priority-area.

name: Nepal BIPAD - hazard and risk map layer catalogue
description: GeoServer layer registry: title and titleNe, category (hazard / exposure / vulnerability), type (raster / vector), workspace and layername needed to pull the layer itself, plus legendTitle, legendDescription and units (e.g. flood depth in metres, 5-year return period).

name: Nepal BIPAD - municipal vulnerability indicators (2021 census)
description: Per-local-unit socio-economic vulnerability block for censusYear 2021: HDI, hpi, percapita income, riskScore, remoteness, and asset counts (radio, computer, internet, telephone, television, jarWater, wellWater), with the municipality/district/province keys and timestamps.

name: Nepal BIPAD - designated emergency open spaces
description: Named emergency evacuation open spaces (e.g. Tundikhel) with openSpaceName, the openSpace id and a full MultiPolygon boundary. Note: limit=50 returns HTTP 500 on this endpoint; limit=5 is the verified working page size.

name: Nepal BIPAD - community spaces register
description: Named community buildings and spaces (e.g. Lama Nagi Museum) with communitySpaceName, communitySpace id and MultiPolygon footprint. limit=50 returns HTTP 500; limit=5 verified.

name: Nepal BIPAD - daily national disaster bulletin
description: Daily rolled-up national bulletin: incidentSummary (numberOfIncidents, numberOfDeath, numberOfInjured, numberOfMissing, cattleLoss, roadBlock, estimatedLoss), peopleLoss broken out by province, the sitrep id it derives from, and createdOn/modifiedOn.

name: Nepal BIPAD - DRR projects register
description: Registered disaster risk reduction projects: title, description of the intervention, the implementing organization id and the wards it covers.

name: Nepal Rastra Bank - site-wide search (WP REST, non-standard /api prefix)
description: Full-text pivot across the central bank's site: each hit gives a flat string title, the canonical url, id and type/subtype (post, page, directive, circular). Dispatchable with a bank or financial-institution name to surface NRB directives, licensing notices and enforcement items naming it. Note the REST root is /api/, not /wp-json/.

name: Sri Lanka RiskInfo (DMC GeoNode) - spatial datasets
description: Disaster Management Centre spatial catalogue: title, name (workspace-qualified layer name), uuid, pk, abstract, subtype (vector/raster), store, charset, temporal flags, the owner block, bounding box and the WMS/WFS/download links needed to actually pull the layer.

name: Sri Lanka RiskInfo - hazard documents and flood maps
description: 41 DMC documents: title, name (e.g. 'Flood Inundation map Kalu River Basin Western Province, 14 October 2024.pdf'), uuid, extension, mime_type, href download link, subtype and the owner record. Operational flood-inundation mapping for named Sri Lankan river basins.

name: Sri Lanka RiskInfo - unified resource index
description: Polymorphic index across every GeoNode object (datasets, documents, maps): title, uuid, pk, resource_type, perms, the owner block with username and the canonical link. Note page_size=50 returns HTTP 500; page_size=5 is the verified working size.

name: Sri Lanka RiskInfo - composed risk maps
description: Published map compositions with title, uuid, pk and the maplayers array naming each constituent dataset (alternate layer name, current_style, extra params) - i.e. which hazard layers were combined for an official risk product.

name: Sri Lanka RiskInfo - keyword index
description: Controlled keyword tree used to tag DMC datasets: id, name (e.g. kurunegala), slug, hierarchical path and depth, usage count and self link. Lets a district name be resolved to the datasets tagged with it.

name: Sri Lanka Customs - site-wide search (WP REST)
description: Free-text pivot over Sri Lanka Customs publications: flat string title, canonical url, id, type and subtype per hit. Dispatch a trader, HS code or commodity name to surface customs notices, gazette tariff changes and enforcement announcements.

name: Securities and Exchange Commission of Sri Lanka - site-wide search
description: Search pivot across the Sri Lankan securities regulator: title, url, id, type/subtype. Hits include named individuals (commission members, licensed persons) and company-specific enforcement and licensing items - dispatchable with a company or director name.

name: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - site-wide search
description: Search across the electricity, water and petroleum regulator: title, url, id, type/subtype. Surfaces licensing decisions, tariff determinations and consultation records by name.

name: Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign Employment - site-wide search
description: Search over the regulator of Sri Lankan labour-migration agencies: title, url, id, type/subtype. Reaches licensed foreign-employment agency notices, suspensions and recruitment announcements - the register behind Sri Lanka's largest remittance channel.

name: Sri Lanka Ministry of Agriculture - site-wide search
description: Search pivot returning title, url, id, type/subtype. Hits include tender notices and named-officer appointment lists (e.g. permanent appointments at the Land Reform Commission).

name: Sri Lanka Ministry of Energy - site-wide search
description: Search over the energy ministry: title, url, id, type/subtype. Carries dated administered fuel-price revisions and petroleum/power sector notices.

name: Pakistan Bureau of Statistics - site-wide search (WP REST)
description: Search pivot over Pakistan's national statistics office: title, url, id, type/subtype. Reaches weekly SPI price bulletins, census releases, CPI/trade statistics and publication pages by free-text query.

name: Pakistan National Accountability Bureau - site-wide search
description: High value: free-text pivot over Pakistan's principal anti-corruption prosecutor. Each hit gives title, url, id and type/subtype, reaching NAB press releases, reference filings, arrest and plea-bargain announcements and inter-agency actions. Dispatchable with a person or company name.

name: Punjab PDMA Pakistan - site-wide search
description: Provincial Disaster Management Authority search: title, url, id, type/subtype. Reaches the dated Daily Situation Report (DSR) series and flood/heatwave advisories for Punjab.

name: Pakistan Business Council - site-wide search
description: Search over the advocacy body of Pakistan's largest corporate groups: title, url, id, type/subtype. Reaches sector position papers, tax submissions and named member-company research.

name: Bhutan Anti-Corruption Commission - site-wide search
description: Free-text pivot over Bhutan's ACC: title, url, id, type/subtype. Reaches National Integrity Assessment findings presented against named agencies, investigation outcomes, asset-declaration notices and debarment announcements.

name: Election Commission of Bhutan - site-wide search
description: Search over Bhutan's electoral authority: title, url, id, type/subtype. Reaches election notifications, candidate and result announcements, and recruitment/appointment results naming individuals.

name: Bhutan Office of the Attorney General - site-wide search
description: Search over Bhutan's OAG: title, url, id, type/subtype. Reaches annual reports (e.g. 'Annual Report, Year 2025-2026'), prosecution statistics and legal opinions.

name: Bhutan Department of Revenue and Customs - site-wide search
description: Search over Bhutan's tax and customs authority: title, url, id, type/subtype. Reaches public tax notifications (e.g. treatment of fixed-deposit interest from 1 January 2026), customs tariff rulings and taxpayer notices.

name: Bhutan Ministry of Foreign Affairs and External Trade - site-wide search
description: Search over Bhutan's MFA: title, url, id, type/subtype. Reaches diplomatic statements, treaty and visa notices, and posted vacancies for named diplomatic positions.

name: Maldives Bureau of Statistics - site-wide search (WP REST)
description: Search pivot over the Maldives national statistics office: title, url, id, type/subtype. Reaches Census 2022 outputs, monthly CPI/ECPI releases and statistical yearbooks.

name: Maldives Ministry of Economic Development and Trade - site-wide search
description: Search over the ministry that runs the Maldives business registry and foreign-investment approvals: title, url, id, type/subtype. Reaches IUL-numbered official announcements, tenders, vacancies and business-registration/licensing notices. Note transport.gov.mv redirects to this same site.

name: ACRA - Entities Registered with ACRA (master UEN roll)
description: Master Singapore UEN roll, 2,112,559 records. Each record: uen, entity_name, entity_type_desc, uen_status_desc (Registered/Deregistered/Terminated), uen_issue_date, reg_street_name, reg_postal_code, issuance_agency_desc. Every record also carries _id as an id-ish fallback. Appending &q= turns it into a name/UEN search pivot.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ACRA Information on Corporate Entities ('A')
description: 174,385 Singapore entities starting with A. 54 fields per record: uen, entity_name, entity_status_description, registration_incorporation_date, full registered address, primary/secondary SSIC code + description, no_of_officers, former_entity_name1..15, and uen_of_audit_firm1..5 / name_of_audit_firm1..5 (company-to-auditor pivot).

name: ACRA Information on Corporate Entities ('B')
description: 94,517 Singapore entities starting with B, same 54-field ACRA schema (status, incorporation date, address, SSIC activity, officer count, 15 former names, 5 audit-firm UEN/name pairs).

name: ACRA Information on Corporate Entities ('C')
description: 140,200 Singapore entities starting with C, full 54-field ACRA schema including officer count, former names and audit-firm links.

name: Jakarta DPMPTSP - Building Worthiness Certificates (SLF) with owner and director identifiers
description: 901 certified buildings from Jakarta's one-stop licensing agency. properties carry BANGUNAN_NAMA (building), BANGUNAN_LOKASI/KEL/KEC/WIL, PEMILIK_NAMA (owning company, e.g. 'PT. Mulia Naga Lestari'), PEMILIK_ALAMAT/TLP/EMAIL, DIRUT_NAMA (managing director), DIRUT_NIK (national ID) and DIRUT_NPWP (tax ID), plus REK_NO/REK_TANGGAL/REK_STATUS. Highest-penetrancy Indonesian row found: building to company to named director to NIK/NPWP.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Jakarta DPMPTSP - Licensed Vehicle Emission Testing Businesses
description: 269 licensed emission-test operators. properties: NO, NAMA_PERUSAHAAN (company), ALAMAT_PERUSAHAAN, LAT/LONG_, SARANA_USAHA and licence columns. Named company plus premises.

name: Jakarta Concrete Batching Plants (with NPWP tax number and permit chain)
description: 41 batching plants, 54 attributes each: NAMA (operator, e.g. 'Saeti Concretindo Wahana'), NPWP (tax ID '01.373.121.1-073.000'), TDP, AKTA_PT (deed), LOKASI_CBP, KESESUAIAN (zoning compliance), JENIS_CBP, IZIN/AMDAL/IMB/AMDAL_UPL environmental-permit numbers, NO_IZIN, TGL_IZIN, MASA_BER, SP1 warning dates. Company-to-tax-ID-to-permit chain.

name: Jakarta DPMPTSP - IMB Building Permits
description: Building permits issued by Jakarta's one-stop service. properties: NAMA_IZIN (permit type), NOMOR_IZIN (full permit number), ALAMAT, WADMKD/WADMKC/WADMKK (village/district/city), X/Y. Permit-number to address pivot.

name: Jakarta Billboard (Reklame) Permit Register - PTSP
description: Billboard/advertising structure register. properties: ID_REKLAME, LOKASI_REKLAME, KEL/KEC/WIL plus codes, JNS_REKLAME, POSISI_REKLAME, KONTENT_REKLAME, STATUS, NAMA_PERUSAHAAN (permit holder), STATUS_STRUKTUR_REK, VERIFIKASI_REK, PETUGAS (inspecting officer), CREATED_USER/DATE. Advertiser-to-structure-to-inspector pivot.

name: Jakarta SIPPT - Land Allocation Permits and Developer Obligations
description: SIPPT land-designation permits used to track developer obligations to the city. properties: ID_SIPPT (e.g. '541-2007'), S_ZONA, KWJB/KET (obligation flag), KELURAHAN/KECAMATAN/WILAYAH_LOKASI, Shape__Area, edit audit trail.

name: Jakarta Inventory of Spatial-Planning Violations in Green Zones (RTH)
description: Buildings inventoried as encroaching on designated green-belt zones. properties: OSM_ID/OSM_WAY_ID, ADDR_STREE, BUILDING, LUAS (area), X/Y, ID_WILAYAH/KECAMATAN/KELURAHAN, KODE_BLOK, SUB_ZONA, ZONA ('Zona Jalur Hijau'), KODE_OPS operational case code, KET_EV. A per-parcel enforcement case list.

name: Jakarta DSDA - Drainage Wells Built by Contracted Providers
description: Per-asset record of infiltration wells delivered by contracted providers. properties: IDDV (asset code 'DVJB - 04432'), LOKASI, WADMKK/WADMKC/WADMKD, LATITUDE/LONGITUDE, JMLTTK, dimensions, JNSSUMUR, SPESIFIKASI, PERUSAHAAN (contractor), BLNPKRJAAN (works month), FOTO evidence link, VERIF_ASET. Contractor-to-delivered-asset pivot.

name: Jakarta SIP - Occupancy / Persil Register
description: Per-parcel occupancy register. properties: ALAMAT_RUMAH_PERSIL, NO_RUMAH, NO_FORM, NAMA_PENGHUNI (named occupant), PENGELUARAN, BERAKHIR (expiry) and related columns. Occupant-to-address pivot.

name: Jakarta Nominative Land Register (city land assets)
description: City-owned land parcels. properties: GUIDASET (asset GUID), KIB (asset book code), KODWIL, WADMKK/WADMKC/WADMKD administrative names and further asset columns. Asset-GUID pivot into Jakarta's asset books.

name: Philippine Standard Geographic Code - Cities and Municipalities
description: 1,656 Philippine cities/municipalities from the PSA standard classification. Fields: name, code (10-digit PSGC), type (City/Mun), zip_code, district. The PSGC code is the join key used by almost every Philippine government dataset, so this is the resolver for PH place references.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Philippine Standard Geographic Code - Provinces
description: 82 provinces with name and 10-digit PSGC code. Detail endpoint returns the single province record.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Philippine Standard Geographic Code - Regions
description: 17 regions with name and PSGC code. The detail form expands a region into its provinces, verified with code 0100000000 (4 provinces returned).  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Vietnam Bank Directory (BIN, SWIFT and short name)
description: 65 Vietnamese banks. Fields: id, name (full legal Vietnamese name), code, bin (6-digit Napas BIN, e.g. 970415), shortName, swift_code (e.g. ICBVVNVX), transferSupported, lookupSupported. Resolves BIN/SWIFT seen in Vietnamese payment artefacts to a named institution.

name: Vietnam Administrative Units - Wards/Communes
description: 10,051 wards/communes. Fields: name (Vietnamese, e.g. 'Phuong Phuc Xa'), code, division_type, codename, district_code linking up to the district list. Lowest-level resolver for Vietnamese addresses.

name: Vietnam Administrative Units - Districts
description: 696 districts. Fields: name, code, division_type, codename, province_code. The detail form with depth=2 expands a district into its wards (verified on code 1, 'Quan Ba Dinh').  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Vietnam Administrative Units - Provinces
description: 63 provinces/centrally-run cities. Fields: name, code, division_type, codename, phone_code, districts. The detail form with depth=2 returns the province plus its 30 districts (verified on code 1, Ha Noi).  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Thailand ThaiWater - Rainfall Today (all telemetry stations)
description: 4,499 station readings. Each record: id, rainfall_value, rainfall_datetime, station_type, plus nested agency (Thai/English ministry and department names), geocode (province/amphoe/tumbon Thai+English) and station (tele_station_name Thai+English, lat/long, oldcode). Station-to-operating-agency pivot across Thai water agencies.

name: Thailand ThaiWater - 24-hour Rainfall (all telemetry stations)
description: 4,018 records: id, rain_24h, rain_1h, rainfall_datetime, station_type, agency (e.g. Department of Water Resources), geocode with warning_zone/area/amphoe/tumbon/province in Thai and English, station with name and coordinates.

name: Thailand ThaiWater - River Water Levels (telemetry, with situation level)
description: 1,429 river gauge readings. Fields: id, waterlevel_datetime, waterlevel_m/msl, flow_rate, discharge, storage_percent, station_type, situation_level (1-5 flood severity), diff_wl_bank_text, river_gid/river_name plus nested agency, basin and station (tele_station_name EN/TH, coordinates). NOTE the document also carries sibling reference arrays (province 80, basin 24, agency 10) - the records are at waterlevel_data.data.

name: Thailand ThaiWater - Yesterday's Rainfall by Named Station
description: 126 daily station totals. Fields: id, tele_station_id, tele_station_name (EN/TH), rainfall_datetime, rainfall_value, province_code/province_name, coordinates, amphoe_name, tumbon_name, agency_name (e.g. Thai Meteorological Department), warning_zone, basin, sub_basin_id, tele_station_oldcode.

name: Myanmar MIMU GeoNode - Spatial Layers
description: 77 Myanmar geospatial layers (village points by region, admin boundaries, forest cover). Fields: id, title, abstract, category__gn_description, date, detail_url, distribution_url, owner__username, csw_wkt_geometry bounding polygon, uuid. Detail fetch on id 804 returned the full metadata record (typename, workspace, store, keywords, regions, temporal extent, owner) - verified.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Myanmar MIMU GeoNode - Documents
description: Documents attached to Myanmar datasets (licences, methodology notes). Fields: id, title, abstract, category__gn_description, date, detail_url, owner__username, uuid.

name: Myanmar MIMU GeoNode - Maps
description: Published Myanmar map compositions (e.g. 'Nay Pyi Taw Villages'). Fields: id, title, abstract, date, detail_url, owner__username, thumbnail_url, uuid.

name: Myanmar MIMU GeoNode - Contributor Profiles
description: 17 contributor accounts behind the Myanmar layers. Fields: id, username, first_name, last_name, organization, position, city, country, email, date_joined, layers_count, maps_count, documents_count, profile_detail_url, activity_stream_url. Turns each layer's owner__username into a named person/organisation - the person-behind-the-record pivot for this GeoNode.

name: Brunei Ministry of Finance and Economy - Notices (tender announcements)
description: Brunei MoFE posting feed, in practice the ministry's tender-notice stream (first record title: 'DAILY COLLECTION AND DISPOSAL OF WASTES FROM WASTE COLLECTION CENTRE IN AYER BERKUNCHI, KAMPONG KASAT FOR A PERIOD OF THREE (03) YEARS'). Fields: id, date, modified, slug, status, link, title.rendered, content.rendered, excerpt, author, categories, tags. Detail fetch on id 8161 returned the full single post - verified. Keep per_page=20 so the root record array is unambiguously the densest.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Brunei Department of Economic Planning and Statistics - Releases
description: DEPS release feed (statistical bulletins, census/enumeration notices such as 'Penyenaraian Tempat Kediaman 3-23 Ogos 2026'). Fields: id, date, modified, slug, status, link, title.rendered, content.rendered, author, categories.

name: Brunei Prime Minister's Office (Jabatan Perdana Menteri) - Announcements
description: Brunei PMO announcement feed. Same WordPress record shape: id, date, modified, slug, status, link, title.rendered, content.rendered, author, categories, tags.

name: Cambodia Ministry of Post and Telecommunications - Announcements
description: Khmer-language ministry feed (ministerial meetings, telecom policy, licensing news). Fields: id, date, modified, slug, status, link, title.rendered (Khmer), content.rendered, author, categories with named category objects, plus a yoast_head_json block carrying headline and author name. Keep per_page=20: at small page sizes the embedded schema @graph arrays can rival the record array.

name: Malaysia National Flood Warning Telemetry Stations
description: 1,276 DID telemetry stations. Fields: station_id, station_name, latitude, longitude, district, state, sub_basin, main_basin, station_type, water_level_current plus normal/alert/warning/danger thresholds, water_level_indicator (e.g. ALERT), water_level_trend, rainfall_latest_1hr, rainfall_total_today, rainfall_indicator, station_status, station_code and update timestamps. Named station with both an id-ish and a name-ish key.

name: ASIC — Australian company register (full)
description: Every company ever registered in Australia: Company Name, ACN, Type, Class, Sub Class, Status (REGD/DRGD), Date of Registration, Date of Deregistration, Previous State of Registration, State Registration number, ABN, Current Name and Current Name Start Date. 4.4M rows, and &q=<name> full-text searches it server-side.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ASIC — Australian business names register
description: Every registered Australian trading name with BN_NAME, BN_STATUS, BN_REG_DT, BN_CANCEL_DT, BN_STATE_NUM, BN_STATE_OF_REG and — the pivot that matters — BN_ABN linking the trading name to the legal entity behind it.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ASIC — banned and disqualified persons
description: Named individuals banned by ASIC: BD_PER_NAME, BD_PER_TYPE (Banned Securities / AFS banning / Credit banning / director disqualification), BD_PER_DOC_NUM, start and end dates of the ban, suburb, state, postcode, country and ASIC's comments.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ASIC — banned and disqualified organisations
description: Corporate entities banned by ASIC: BD_ORG_ACN, BD_ORG_NAME, BD_ORG_TYPE, ban start and end dates, an ASIC reference URL and comments. Small register but it names companies, and the ACN pivots straight into the 4.4M-row company register.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ASIC — registered liquidators
description: Every registered and official liquidator in Australia: LIQ_NAME, LIQ_NUM, OFF_LIQ_NUM, registration start dates, LIQ_STATUS, suspension date, locality/state/postcode and LIQ_FIRM — the insolvency practitioner behind a collapse, tied to their firm.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ASIC — registered company auditors
description: Registered auditors and audit firms: REG_AUD_NAME, REG_AUD_NUM, REG_AUD_ACN, registration date, status, suspension date and address. The ACN links an audit firm to its own company record.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ASIC — Australian Financial Services licensees
description: AFS licence holders: AFS_LIC_NUM, AFS_LIC_NAME, AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN, licence start date, pre-FSR authorisations, address, and the full AFS_LIC_CONDITION text spelling out exactly what financial products the licensee may deal in and advise on.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ASIC — AFS authorised representatives
description: 363k authorised representatives sitting under AFS licensees: AFS_REP_NAME, AFS_REP_NUM, the AFS_LIC_NUM they act for, AFS_REP_ABN/ACN, appointment and cessation dates, status, address, cross-endorsement flag and per-authorisation columns. This is the person-behind-the-licensee layer.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ASIC — Australian credit licensees
description: Credit licence holders: CRED_LIC_NUM, CRED_LIC_NAME, CRED_LIC_ABN_ACN, linked AFSL number, status and status history, locality/state/postcode with latitude and longitude, external dispute resolution scheme, registered business names and the full authorisations text.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ASIC — credit representatives
description: Credit representatives and the licensee that appointed them: CRED_REP_NAME, CRED_REP_NUM, CRED_LIC_NUM, ABN/ACN, appointment and end dates, locality/state/postcode, EDR scheme and authorisations. Pairs with the credit-licensee register to build the appointment chain.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ASIC — Financial Advisers Register
description: Every financial adviser on ASIC's register: ADV_NAME, ADV_NUMBER, ADV_ROLE and sub-type, role status, adviser ABN, year first provided advice, LICENCE_NAME / LICENCE_NUMBER / LICENCE_ABN and LICENCE_CONTROLLED_BY, start and end dates, overall registration status and CPD failure year.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ASIC — approved SMSF auditors
description: Approved self-managed-super-fund auditors: SMSF_NAME, SMSF_NUM, status, person ABN, registration and suspension dates, locality/state/postcode, the firm they act through (SMSF_CAPACITY_FIRM_NAME) and any ASIC-imposed condition with its full text and condition number.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ACNC — Australian charities register
description: Every registered Australian charity: ABN, Charity_Legal_Name, Other_Organisation_Names, full street address, Charity_Website, Registration_Date, Date_Organisation_Established, Charity_Size, Number_of_Responsible_Persons, financial year end and per-state operating flags.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ACNC — 2024 Annual Information Statement
description: The financial and activity return each Australian charity files: abn, charity name, registration status, website, size, basic-religious-charity flag, AIS due date, dates the AIS and financial report were received, whether activities were conducted, and a long block of international-activity disclosures (transferring goods or services overseas, operating overseas).  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Australian Government historical contract notices
description: Commonwealth contract notices with Agency Name, Parent Contract ID, Contract ID (CN number), Publish/Start/End dates, Value, amendment date and amendment value, Description, Agency Ref ID and UNSPSC code — the award trail behind a federal supplier.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Australian Government Organisations Register
description: Every Commonwealth body: Id (O-xxxxxx), Title, Portfolio, Classification (primary body / subsidiary), Type of Body (non-corporate Commonwealth entity, company, statutory authority), GFS sector classification, materiality and a prose description. Maps the federal entity graph.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: NDIS Quality and Safeguards Commission — compliance actions
description: Regulatory actions against NDIS providers: Type (revocation of registration, banning order, compliance notice), Date effective from, Date no longer in force, provider Name including trading name, ABN, city/state/postcode, provider number and the registration groups affected. Names companies and the sanction against them.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: APVMA PUBCRIS — registered agvet chemical products
description: Registered agricultural and veterinary chemical products with pcode, regno and regdate. Thin: only three data columns, so the emitted label is the row number rather than a product name — useful as a registration-number index, not as a browsable list.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: IP Australia IPGOD — IP right records
description: Australian intellectual-property rights: ip_right_type and sub_type (pbr, patent, trade mark), application_number, status, earliest filed date, priority date, date registration and enforceable status were gained, enforceable-from and deemed-retired dates.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: AusTender — OCDS contract releases (published)
description: Full Open Contracting releases for Commonwealth contracts published in a date window. Each release carries a parties[] array naming the supplier with its AU-ABN additionalIdentifier and address, plus the buyer, tender, award and contract blocks. Keyless, and the date range is the pagination handle.

name: AusTender — OCDS contract amendments (last modified)
description: The same OCDS release structure filtered on last-modified date, which surfaces contract AMENDMENTS — value variations and extensions that never appear in the original publication feed. Same parties[]/ABN payload. Other valid dateTypes on this endpoint are contractStart and contractEnd.

name: Victorian Building Authority — building practitioner register
description: Registered Victorian building practitioners: Account Name, Type (Person / Company), Accreditation ID, Accreditation Status, ABN, ACN, Limitation (e.g. Commercial Builder - Limited) and commenced/expires dates. The ABN and ACN pivot into the ASIC company register.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Queensland — environmental enforcement actions register
description: Queensland environmental enforcement orders naming the recipient: Enforcement Reference, Enforcement Type (Environmental Enforcement Order, Transitional Environmental Program), Issued To (person or company), CC To, Issued Date, Status, Activities, Locations (lot/plan), related environmental authority, evaluator name and subsequent action.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Queensland — environmental authorities (permit holders)
description: Queensland environmental permits: Permit Reference, Permit Type, Permit Holder(s) (named company), Effective Date, Status (Granted/Surrendered), Condition Type, Industry, the specific Environmentally Relevant Activities authorised and locations. Facility-level regulatory footprint behind a corporate name.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Queensland Government contracts directory — awarded contracts
description: Awarded Queensland state contracts: Agency Name and Agency Address, contract Description, Date, Value, Supplier Name and Supplier Address. Supplier addresses at street level make this unusually good for entity resolution.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Queensland Health — grant funding recipients
description: Organisations funded by Queensland Health: Organisation Name, Project Title, description of the funded services, Contract End Date and the funding amount per financial year. Follows public money to named non-government providers.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Queensland — supplier procurement arrangements directory
description: Standing offer arrangements: ID ref, Arrangement Number, Arrangement Name, State (Published), Categories / Subcategories / Product and Service Groups, Start and Expiry dates, Status and access permission. The panel structure suppliers sit inside.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Queensland — registered water service providers
description: Registered drinking-water and sewerage service providers: Name (literal field), SPID, and boolean flags for drinking water provider, water service and sewerage service. Small register but the label field is an exact 'Name'.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Queensland — resource authority holder name changes
description: Mining and petroleum permit holder renames: Permit Number, Permit Type, Activity ID, Authorised Holder, Completion Date, LGA, and Notes spelling out the old and new corporate names verbatim. Tiny but it is a direct corporate-rename ledger for resource tenements.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Hong Kong Companies Registry — newly registered non-Hong Kong companies (weekly)
description: Foreign companies newly registered to carry on business in Hong Kong: Seq, Current Corporate Name / Other Corporate Name, Current Approved Name for Carrying on Business in H.K., BR Number, Date of Registration and Date of Change of name. Each entity appears twice, once in Latin script and once in Chinese, sharing a Seq — the cross-script alias pair is itself the intel.

name: Korea MOLEG — English-titled statute search
description: Korean statutes with both Korean and ENGLISH names: id, 법령ID, 법령일련번호 (MST), 법령명한글, 법령명영문 (e.g. FAIR TRANSACTIONS IN FRANCHISE BUSINESS ACT), 법령구분명, 소관부처명 (competent ministry), 공포번호, 공포일자, 시행일자 and a detail link. Keyless — OC=test is the documented public demo id and it works.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Korea — Supreme Court and lower court precedent search
description: Korean court judgments matching a query: id, 사건번호 (case number, e.g. 대법원-2025-두-34754), 사건명 (case name, which names the parties), 선고일자, 법원명, 사건종류명, 판례일련번호 and 판례상세링크. The detail service returns 판시사항, 판결요지 and the full reasoning. This is Korea's case-law layer, keyless.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Korea — municipal ordinance and rule search
description: Local-government ordinances: id, 자치법규ID, 자치법규명, 자치법규일련번호, 지자체기관명 (the specific city/gu that enacted it, e.g. 서울특별시 송파구), 자치법규종류, 시행일자 and detail link. Ties regulatory action to a named Korean local authority.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Korea Constitutional Court — decision search
description: Constitutional Court rulings: id, 사건번호 (e.g. 2002헌가20), 종국일자, 사건명 naming the statute under challenge, 헌재결정례일련번호 and detail link. The detail service returns the reviewed provision text and the full reasoning.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Korea MOLEG — official statutory interpretations
description: Binding legal interpretations issued by the Ministry of Government Legislation: id, 안건명 (the question asked), 안건번호, 회신기관명 and code (who answered), 질의기관명 and code (which agency asked), 회신일자 and 법령해석례일련번호. The detail service returns the full 이유 reasoning. Shows which agency was uncertain about which rule.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Korea — administrative appeal (행정심판) rulings
description: Rulings on administrative appeals against government decisions: id, 재결청 (adjudicating body, e.g. 국민권익위원회), 처분청 (the agency whose decision was challenged), 사건번호, 사건명 describing the contested disposition, 의결일자, 처분일자 and 행정심판재결례일련번호. The detail service returns 청구취지 and full reasoning. Citizen-vs-agency disputes that never reach a court.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Korea — treaty register search
description: Treaties Korea is party to: id, 조약명 (naming the counterparty state), 서명일자, 조약번호, 조약구분코드 (bilateral/multilateral) and 관보게제일자 (official gazette publication date). Bilateral instruments behind Korean trade and investment relationships.

name: Taiwan GCIS — company financial and control record by unified business number
description: The by-UBN detail record the tree's name-search row is missing: Business_Accounting_NO, Company_Name, Company_Status_Desc, Capital_Stock_Amount, Paid_In_Capital_Amount, Share_Val, Equity_Amt, Responsible_Name (the legal representative), Company_Location, Register_Organization_Desc (the registering authority), Company_Setup_Date, Change_Of_Approval_Data, Revoke_App_Date and suspension dates. Paid-in capital and the responsible person are the two fields the name-search endpoint does not return.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Taiwan GCIS — company record with licensed business scope
description: Company record plus the nested Cmp_Business array: every licensed business item the company may legally conduct, with Business_Seq_NO, Business_Item (the MOEA code, e.g. CC01080) and Business_Item_Desc. TSMC alone returns 17 items. Reveals what a Taiwanese entity is actually permitted to do, which often contradicts its stated line of business.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Taiwan GCIS — unified business number to company name resolver
description: Minimal two-field lookup returning Business_Accounting_NO and Company_Name. Cheap canonical-name resolution for a Taiwanese UBN harvested from an invoice, tender award or shipping manifest, before spending a request on the fuller registry endpoints.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Pacific Data Hub Microdata Library — survey and census catalogue
description: 693 microdata collections across the Pacific Islands from SPC's NADA catalogue: id, idno (e.g. SPC_ASM_2025_PHC_v01_M), title, nation (American Samoa, Fiji, PNG, Samoa, Vanuatu, Solomon Islands, Tonga...), authoring_entity (the national statistics office that ran it), year_start/year_end, type (survey/census), repositoryid and repo_title. The detail hop returns full study metadata including variable count. Fills the Pacific-island gap where no company registry API exists.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: IFRC GO — field reports (operational situation reports)
description: Per-emergency field report: title, casualty/affected counts (num_dead, num_injured, num_missing, num_displaced, gov_ and other_ variants), epidemic case counts, DREF/appeal amounts requested, ERU deployment flags by unit type, national-society contacts, countries/districts, actions taken. The detail hop with a real id (18533) returns the same record plus full contact and action narrative.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: IFRC GO — 3W national-society projects
description: Who-does-what-where: project name, reporting national society, beneficiary country and districts, sector, programme/operation type, budget_amount, actual_expenditure, target vs reached beneficiaries split by sex, start/end dates. Detail hop verified with id 2510.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: IFRC GO — surge personnel deployments
description: Individual surge deployments: delegate name (often null in the public feed, which is why the label falls to id), role, deployment type (FACT/RDRT/ERU), country_from and country_to with national society, start/end dates, molnix roster id. Names people to operations — a rare personnel-level humanitarian record.

name: IFRC GO — appeal documents
description: Every DREF/emergency-appeal document with its download URL, document type, appeal code (MDRxxNNN), the parent appeal object with its event and start date, and country ISO. The document_url is a direct file link into go-api.ifrc.org.

name: IFRC GO — national societies directory
description: 281 countries/territories with the Red Cross/Red Crescent national society name, society URL, IFRC directory URL, FDRS code, postal address, phone, emails, website, INFORM risk score, bbox and centroid. Detail hop (id 14) adds contacts and NSI income/expenditure/branch counts.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: IFRC GO — subnational districts gazetteer
description: Admin-1 gazetteer used to geocode every IFRC field report and project: district name, code, parent country name/ISO/ISO3, NUTS1/2/3 codes, FIPS code, EMMA id, World Bank population and year, bbox and centroid.

name: IFRC GO — regional focal points
description: Named IFRC regional focal points with personal name, email address and the geographic extent they cover. Small but it is real named-individual contact data.

name: WHO — collaborating centres directory
description: Designated WHO Collaborating Centres worldwide: reference code (e.g. KOR-106), TitleOfTheCentre (the actual institution), host website, date of designation, last redesignation, expiry date, WHOCC portal URL. Institution-level records tying named research bodies to WHO. Detail hop verified with a real GUID.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: WHO — emergencies register
description: WHO-graded emergencies: title (e.g. Ebola outbreak North Kivu/Ituri DRC), start and end dates, emergency rating, overview and summary HTML, canonical URL slug.

name: WHO — emergency events
description: Event taxonomy behind the outbreak news — event title (Cholera, Mpox…), EventId, event start date. This is the key that joins WHO Disease Outbreak News items to a named event.

name: WHO — member state register
description: Country records with official name, colloquial synonyms, ISO numeric, two-letter code, WHO code, member-state flag, WHO relationship type and country overview text.

name: WHO — governing-body documents
description: WHO document register: document title, publication year, alternate/canonical URL to the PDF, publication date, provider.

name: WHO — programme activities
description: Named WHO programme activities with title, summary, impact statistics, publication datetime and canonical URL — what WHO is actually running, country by country.

name: WHO — official biographies
description: Biography records for WHO officials and directors: title, biography HTML, summary, parent record id linking the person to their unit. Named-person data inside a UN agency.

name: WHO — publications catalogue
description: Publication records with title, editors, ISBN, page count, download links, overview and highlights — including weekly surveillance bulletins (dracunculiasis, meningitis) that carry live case counts.

name: WHO — meeting reports
description: Reports of WHO expert meetings and weekly epidemiological bulletins: title, subtitle, ISBN, overview, publication datetime, related-item counts.

name: WHO — Director-General and senior speeches
description: Full speech records: title, occasion, Location (where it was delivered), publication datetime, speech duration and the complete Content body.

name: WHO — partner organizations
description: Organizations WHO names as partners/donors (first record: Global Environment Facility) with organization title and WebsiteURL — an org-to-org relationship list.

name: WHO — policy indicator register
description: Named policy/regulatory indicators (e.g. alcohol advertising restrictions on social media) with footnote, WHO priority level, IMR definition id and parent grouping.

name: WHO — health topics
description: WHO health-topic records (including Biological weapons) with summary, three tabbed sections of body text, technical links and canonical URL.

name: WHO — departments
description: WHO internal departments (R&D Blueprint etc.) with title, external page URL and canonical slug — the org chart backing the biographies and programmes feeds.

name: WHO — programmes
description: Named WHO programmes with title, publication date and canonical URL.

name: WHO — SDG goal records
description: WHO's own SDG entries: goal title, goal number, description, summary, external link and colour code.

name: WHO — normative recommendations
description: WHO guideline recommendations (e.g. insecticide-treated nets) with the full recommendation Body and the IRIS document id (IRISID) that links to the source guideline.

name: WHO — country profiles
description: Per-country thematic profiles (e.g. Oral Health Egypt 2022) with report start and end dates and canonical URL.

name: WHO — news items
description: WHO newsroom items with title, news type, provider, publication datetime and canonical URL. Distinct collection from the diseaseoutbreaknews feed already in the tree.

name: UN Statistics — SDG goals
description: The 17 SDG goals with code, title, description and API uri. Detail hop verified with code 1 — returns that goal's targets, so this is the entry point to the whole SDG tree.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: UN Statistics — SDG targets
description: All 169 SDG targets with goal, code (1.1), full target text, description and the nested indicator list belonging to each target.

name: UN Statistics — SDG indicators
description: 251 official SDG indicators: goal, target, indicator code, full description, tier classification and the nested series that measure it. Detail hop verified with code 1.1.1 — returns every data series under that indicator.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: UN Statistics — SDG data series
description: 713 SDG data series with series code (DC_ODA_BDVDL), the goals/targets/indicators each maps to, release version and full description — the code list you need to query Series/Data.

name: UN Statistics — SDG geo areas
description: 460 UN M49 geographic areas (countries, regions, aggregates) with geoAreaCode and geoAreaName — the join key for every SDG observation.

name: UN Statistics — SDG observations (extreme poverty series)
description: Actual SDG observations: geoAreaCode/geoAreaName, time period, value, upper and lower bound, base period, the named source institution, footnotes and the full attribute/dimension breakdown. 11,407 rows for this one series; swap seriesCode for any of the 713. Array is at data — the response also carries attributes and dimensions arrays that would fool the auto-detector.

name: UNHCR — refugee population by origin and asylum country
description: Origin-country x asylum-country pairs with refugees, asylum_seekers, returned_refugees, IDPs, returned_idps, stateless, others of concern and host-community counts. coo_all/coa_all are REQUIRED — without them every row collapses to '-' and the parser drops the lot.

name: UNHCR — asylum decisions
description: Asylum decision outcomes per origin/asylum pair: recognised, other outcome, rejected, closed, total, plus procedure type, decision level and protection category. 2.16 million decisions in 2024 alone.

name: UNHCR — asylum applications
description: New asylum applications lodged, by origin and asylum country, with procedure type, application type, decision level and protection category.

name: UNHCR — durable solutions
description: Returned refugees, resettlement departures, naturalisations and returned IDPs by origin and asylum country — who actually left the caseload and how.

name: UNHCR — demographics of displaced populations
description: Age/sex disaggregation of displaced populations by asylum country: female and male counts in bands 0-4, 5-11, 12-17, 18-59, 60+, other and totals.

name: UNHCR — UNRWA registered Palestine refugees
description: UNRWA-registered Palestine refugee totals by field of operation (State of Palestine, Jordan, Lebanon, Syria).

name: World Bank — debarred and cross-debarred firms and individuals
description: THE World Bank sanctions list, 1,530 entries: SUPP_NAME (firm or named individual), SUPP_ID, entity type (I=individual/F=firm), full street address, city, country, ineligibility from/to dates, the grounds for debarment and cross-debarment status under the MDB agreement. The label lands on COUNTRY_NAME because country_name outranks the _NAME suffix fallback in the parser; SUPP_NAME is still in every record's props. Key is published in clear in the public debarred-firms page source, not private.

name: World Bank — microdata survey catalogue
description: Survey and census catalogue across the World Bank, UNHCR, IHSN and national statistics offices: title, idno, DOI, survey type, country, authoring entity, collection years, form model, repository. Detail hop verified with idno AFG_2024_CBPM-Q3_v01_M (note: it takes the idno string, NOT the numeric id — the numeric id returns IDNO-NOT-FOUND).  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: IFC — investment project disclosures
description: Newly disclosed IFC investment projects with CompanyName (the actual private counterparty, e.g. JUMIA TECHNOLOGIES AG), ProjectNumber, ProjectName, country, region, industry, environmental category, status, disclosed date, project overview, the eight IFC Performance Standard flags and MultiLatitude/MultiLongitude. Small window (5) but it is the private-sector-counterparty surface of the World Bank Group, refreshed as projects disclose.

name: UNDP — transparency portal projects
description: UNDP project register: project_id, title, description, budget and expense in USD, country, sector list with codes, SDG mappings, signature solution, donor list and gender/policy markers. The year parameter is mandatory — without it the API returns 400.

name: Green Climate Fund — approved projects
description: All 372 GCF projects: ProjectName, approved reference (FP001), board meeting, theme, sector, lifetime CO2, risk category, direct and indirect beneficiaries, total GCF funding, co-financing, total value, project URL, plus nested Countries, accredited Entities, Disbursements, Funding tranches and ResultAreas. Detail hop verified with ProjectsID 13020.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: UNESCO UIS — geographic units
description: 462 UIS geographic units with ISO3 id, name and type (NATIONAL/REGIONAL) — the geography codelist for UNESCO education statistics. The sibling indicators endpoint is already in the tree; the actual data endpoint is NOT returned because its records carry no name-ish or id-ish field.

name: UNICEF — SDMX dataflow catalogue
description: 42 UNICEF statistical dataflows (CAUSE_OF_DEATH, immunisation, child protection…) with id, human name, multilingual names, version, agency and the URN of the data structure behind each — the map of what UNICEF publishes and how to query it.

name: ILOSTAT — SDG 1.1.1 working poverty series
description: ILO's keyless plumber API: ref_area (ISO3), named source series, indicator code, sex, age classification, time and obs_value with observation status. 2,088 observations for this one indicator from 2023; the id parameter swaps in any ILOSTAT indicator code (an unfiltered pull of EMP_TEMP_SEX_AGE_NB_A returned 54 MB, so keep timefrom set).

name: IATI Datastore (iati.cloud) — aid activities
description: 425,402 IATI activities published by every bilateral and multilateral donor — iati_identifier, title narratives, reporting org, participating orgs with role, recipient countries, sectors, budgets, planned disbursements and transactions. This is the keyless mirror of the IATI Datastore (api.iatistandard.org requires a subscription key). The q and fl parameters are BOTH required: without q the docs array is empty, and without fl=id the records carry only multi-valued arrays and every one is dropped for want of a scalar label.

name: IATI Datastore (iati.cloud) — aid transactions
description: Individual aid transactions under each activity: transaction_ref, type (commitment/disbursement/expenditure), date, value in original currency and USD, provider and receiver organisation refs and narratives, recipient country and sector. Money-level granularity beneath the activity. Same fl=id requirement as the activity endpoint.

name: IATI Datastore (iati.cloud) — publishing organisations
description: Organisation files: organisation-identifier (US-GOV-1), name narratives, reporting org ref and type, total budget with period and budget lines, recipient-country and recipient-region budgets, total expenditure with expense lines, and document links. The org-level financial statement behind every IATI publisher.

name: IATI Datastore (iati.cloud) — activity results and indicators
description: Results framework attached to aid activities: result title and description, indicator measure and title, baseline, period start/end, target and actual values with location refs and comments, plus the parent activity's iati-identifier, reporting org and dataset provenance. Note the label value is the result type code ('1'), so titles are weak — result_title and the indicator narrative are in props.
